failure_details.title: SYNTHETIC - Boiler feed pump B tripped on low suction pressure
failure_details.corrective_action:
1. Replaced the suction strainer basket
2. Flushed the suction line
3. Restarted pump and monitored for 4 hours
failure_details.preventive_action: Add strainer differential pressure reading to the weekly rounds sheet

failure_details.title: SYNTHETIC - Cooling water pump motor high winding temperature
failure_details.corrective_action: Cleaned motor cooling fins and fan cowl
failure_details.preventive_action:
Thermography survey every 3 months
Review motor loading against pump curve

failure_details.title: SYNTHETIC - Instrument air compressor A unplanned stop during load change
failure_details.corrective_action: Reset compressor controller and replaced discharge temperature switch
failure_details.preventive_action: Include the switch in the yearly trip test programme
